items.name: Villondi Theertham
items.description: Freshwater spring spot near the sea. A sacred site with Rama-era mythic associations and tranquil surroundings. Perfect for a peaceful spiritual experience.

items.name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial
items.description: Memorial honoring India's Missile Man with gallery depicting awards and memories. A patriotic site celebrating the life of India's great scientist.

items.name: Pamban Bridge
items.description: India's first sea bridge with both railway and road integration. An engineering marvel where trains glide over the ocean.

items.name: Panchamukhi Anjaneya Temple
items.description: Five-faced Hanuman temple with a unique idol. A powerful prayer place with Ram Setu-linked spiritual significance.

items.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple
items.description: Sacred Jyotirlinga Temple of Lord Shiva. One of the 12 Jyotirlingas associated with Ram Setu and a monumental temple complex.

items.name: Agni Theertham
items.description: Holy sea bathing spot opposite Ramanathaswamy Temple. A sacred site for ritual baths with mythic ties to the Ramayana.

items.name: Dhanushkodi & Arichal Munai
items.description: Scenic and historic spot at the Land's End of India. Featuring Arichal Munai with coastal views and Ram Setu mythic legacy.
